summary: The Oregon Tourism Commission met on May 14 to acknowledge meeting notices, introduce members and partners, and vote to advance three candidates (Kavita Dugan, Stacy Shaw, Kate Sinner) to the next interview round for the Executive Director position.
minutes: Chair opened the meeting, confirmed public‑meeting notice compliance and listed agenda availability.
Commissioners introduced themselves and the DOJ Labor and Employment representative was noted.
Jackie Zavitz from Hydrogen Struggles introduced the executive search firm assisting with the Executive Director recruitment.
Chair recapped the candidate pool and noted an earlier executive session with no decisions made.
A motion was made and seconded to advance candidates Kavita Dugan, Stacy Shaw, and Kate Sinner to the next interview round; roll‑call vote approved the motion.
Chair announced upcoming executive sessions and public meetings for the hiring process and adjourned the meeting.
decisions: Approved advancing candidates Kavita Dugan, Stacy Shaw, and Kate Sinner to the next interview round for the Travel Oregon Executive Director position.
